sections.Profile:
"Tic & Toc," released by Europlay in 1974, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine with a billiards theme. The playfield features two flippers, one pop bumper, four slingshots, twenty standup targets, and a seven-bank drop target assembly.

- Manufacturer: Europlay
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme, 1970s, Games
